title: Integrated English I: Main Exam, 17 August 2021
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Highlight three types of sentence with an example in each case.
State the types of conjunctions with examples.
Highlight four examples of collective nouns.
What kinds of relationships do prepositions establish in sentence construction?
State any four types of nouns.
Underline the error in the sentences below and rewrite the sentences correctly.
Either cars or a bus are useful for the trip.
The voters with the candidate was disappointed.
A cup of tea or glass of milk is good for you.
Distinguish between subject and predicate and provide a relevant example.

items.text: Give four sentences for each pattern below. i) S.V.O. ii) S.V.A. iii) S.V.O.O. iv) S.V.O.C. v) S.V.O.A.

parts.text: Explain any five types of phrases using relevant examples.
Differentiate between inflectional and derivational morphemes using examples.

items.text: Write short notes on the following. i) Free and bound morphemes ii) Stem, root and base iii) Open and closed words iv) Allomorph
